pokedexEntries.go: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.

pokedexEntries.si: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

pokedexEntries.cr: This POKéMON uses the bright part of its body, which changed from a dorsal fin, to lure prey.

pokedexEntries.ru: LANTURN is nicknamed “the deep-sea star” for its illuminated antenna. This POKéMON produces light by causing a chemical reaction between bacteria and its bodily fluids inside the antenna.

pokedexEntries.sa: LANTURN is known to emit light. If you peer down into the dark sea from a ship at night, you can sometimes see this POKéMON’s light rising from the depths where it swims. It gives the sea an appearance of a starlit night.

pokedexEntries.fr: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

pokedexEntries.lg: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.

pokedexEntries.em: The light-emitting orbs on its back are very bright. They are formed from a part of its dorsal fin. This POKéMON illuminates the inky darkness of deep seas.

pokedexEntries.dpp: LANTURN’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”

pokedexEntries.su: Should you peer into the ocean at night and see a light shining like the stars, that is Lanturn.

pokedexEntries.mo: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

pokedexEntries.us: When the bacteria living inside its antennae absorb Lanturn’s bodily fluids, a strong luminescent effect is produced.

pokedexEntries.um: It lives far down in the depths of the ocean. It blinds its prey with light, using the moment they’re dazzled to swallow them whole.
